If you're using DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in production, the input price moved twice in one week: Oct 26 : $0.02 input / $1.00 output per million tokens Oct 31 : $0.045 input / $0.50 output per million tokens So input got more than doubled (from $0.02 to $0.045), while output got cut in half (from $1.00 to $0.50). The net effect depends entirely on your workload. If you're doing something input-heavy — long context retrieval, document processing, big system prompts — this week ended up more expensive for you. If you're generating a lot of output relative to input, you came out ahead.

articles.title: WARN Act and Stock Options: What Happens to Your RSUs and Options After a Layoff
articles.excerpt: WARN Act and Stock Options: What Happens to Your RSUs and Options After a Layoff A WARN notice tells you that a layoff is planned. It does not, by itself, tell you what happens to your stock options o…
articles.body: WARN Act and Stock Options: What Happens to Your RSUs and Options After a Layoff A WARN notice tells you that a layoff is planned. It does not, by itself, tell you what happens to your stock options or restricted stock units (RSUs). Those answers usually live in your equity plan, your grant agreement, and your separation agreement. Because the deadlines can be short, equity is one of the first things to check after a notice arrives. The WARN Act is a notice law. It generally requires covered employers to give 60 days' advance notice of a qualifying plant closing or mass layoff. It does not set rules for vesting, exercise windows, or forfeiture, so two workers in the same layoff can face different equity outcomes.

articles.title: PNG to DDS: What Your Game Texture Actually Needs
articles.excerpt: You've finished editing a texture as a PNG. The colors look right, the transparent edges look clean, and the file opens normally in your image editor. Then the modding guide asks for a DDS file. That…
articles.body: You've finished editing a texture as a PNG. The colors look right, the transparent edges look clean, and the file opens normally in your image editor. Then the modding guide asks for a DDS file. That sounds like a small export task, and often it is. The useful question is what the receiving project expects from that DDS: which texture encoding it can read, how it uses transparency, and whether it needs smaller versions of the image for rendering at a distance. Understanding those requirements makes PNG-to-DDS conversion much easier to evaluate, whether you're preparing one replacement texture or a collection of related assets. DDS describes more than one kind of texture A .dds extension identifies a container used for texture data.
articles.author: dev Kane

articles.body: LLM Evaluation That Actually Compares: Inside the FreeCAD Fix Benchmark TL;DR: Most LLM evaluation is a vibe check with a leaderboard. The LFORLA FreeCAD Fix benchmark is different: it uses the same prompts, a deterministic geometry oracle instead of an LLM judge, per-axis rubrics, and a public verbatim trail so you can re-read exactly what each model answered. Here is how it produces numbers you can actually compare. How the evaluation works The FreeCAD Fix benchmark asks a single, concrete task: diagnose and repair a broken parametric FreeCAD script. The model receives the same broken script and the same instructions every time. No prompt drift, no hidden context, no creative reinterpretation. Scoring is where most benchmarks get fuzzy. This one does not use an LLM judge.

articles.title: 20 Years Later, The Departed's Best Line Is Still One Of The Greatest Quotes In Gangster Movie History
articles.excerpt: Jack Nicholson delivered mob cinema's ultimate statement of power.
articles.body: In crime cinema, a lethal line of dialogue can carry just as much weight as a loaded gun. Martin Scorsese's Goodfellas hooks audiences with Henry Hill's seductive declaration, “As far back as I can remember, I always wanted to be a gangster,” framing a life of crime as the ultimate aspiration. Miller's Crossing features Tom Reagan's wonderfully blunt take on underworld survival, while Casino , Scarface , and The Godfather overflow with dialogue that has long since bled into the cultural lexicon. Immortal phrases like “keep your friends close, but your enemies closer” and “an offer you can’t refuse” remain cinematic icons right alongside the actors and directors who brought them to life.

articles.body: Somewhere in Middle-earth, is there a Chili’s that serves orcs? Does an Uruk-hai host greet hungry customers, tell them it’ll be a 20-minute wait, and hand them a menu? Does the kitchen run out of manflesh halfway through the dinner rush? Is halfling served as an appetizer? What precisely is in the Triple Dipper? These are unreasonable questions to ask of an otherwise perfect fantasy epic. Unfortunately, The Lord of the Rings : The Two Towers invites every one of them with one line that feels deeply anachronistic.

articles.excerpt: On Episode 234 of This Week In Space, Tariq Malik and Mike Wall are joined by Than Putzig of the Planetary Science Institute about a NASA-backed payload bound for the Marius Hills Pit on the moon.
articles.body: On Episode 234 of This Week In Space , Tariq Malik and Mike Wall are joined by Than Putzig of the Planetary Science Institute about a NASA-backed payload bound for the Marius Hills Pit on the moon. In our ongoing quest to develop a moon base, could we possibly utilize the area beneath the surface of the moon in order to make the moon habitable? Could Marius Hills Pit, a roughly 50-meter-wide opening that may lead into a lunar lava tube, become the Moon's first living habitat for humans? Putzig explains how geophysical instruments on a rover could detect hidden voids beneath the surface and measure the size of these lava tubes.

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 31, 2015: Creepy skull-shaped Halloween asteroid flies by Earth, NASA names it the 'Great Pumpkin'
articles.excerpt: On October 31, 2015, an asteroid shaped like a human skull flew by Earth. Here's why it was so creepy.
articles.body: On October 31, 2015, an asteroid shaped like a human skull flew by Earth. It arrived with excellent timing on Halloween, which made the already-creepy asteroid even creepier. During its closest approach, the creepy asteroid was about 300,000 miles from Earth, or 1.3 times the average distance between Earth and the moon . So, it didn't pose a threat to our planet. It was discovered by astronomers at Hawaii's Pan-STARRS observatory only three weeks before the flyby, and it was given the official designation "2015 TB145." But no one knew what it looked like until the day before Halloween, when the Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico captured the first radar images.
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

articles.title: The moon, Mars, and Jupiter shine in the heart of the Lion overnight on Nov. 1-2
articles.excerpt: The waning moon shines with Jupiter, Mars and the brilliant star Regulus in the eastern sky overnight Nov. 1-2.
articles.body: The moon dives towards the glowing heart of the constellation Leo for a spectacular rendezvous with Mars and Jupiter overnight on Nov. 1-2, as the glittering stars of the Beehive Cluster shine nearby. Here's what you need to know. Look to the eastern horizon an hour after midnight to see the 45%-lit waning moon shining less than 5 degrees from the red light of Mars — roughly the width of your three middle fingers held at arm's length to the night sky. Jupiter's bright light will gleam just below the red planet, with the bright star Regulus lining up beyond to form a dazzling procession leading back to the horizon. The stars of the Beehive Cluster (M44) can be found twinkling 10 degrees from the unlit side of the lunar disk around this time, in the middle of the constellation Cancer .
